data.name: atdepth MRV
data.description: atdepth MRV is an MIT spin-off based in Cambridge, Massachusetts that provides Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) services to the marine carbon dioxide removal (mCDR) industry. The company builds GPU-based ocean and biogeochemical modeling systems combined with in-situ monitoring to quantify carbon removal for mCDR operators such as Deep Sky. It was funded via ARPA-E's SEA-CO2 program and the BlueSwell accelerator.
